newsitem.title: USA: Kennecott smelter heads towards full output.
newsitem.headline: Kennecott smelter heads towards full output.

text.p: Kennecott Copper said Tuesday its Bingham Canyon copper smelter will not reach its design production capacity of 310,000 short tons a year until first quarter 1997.
The smelter, which was comissioned in 1995, has suffered from operational problems that have kept it from producing at maximum levels.
Bruce Farmer, president of Kennecott Utah Copper Corp, said the smelter was currently operating at about 75 percent of capacity.
But Farmer said the smelter's ability to operate at full capacity was dependent on no further techincal problems.
The new $1 billion smelter project began operating in June 1995.
